ModMetaData.name: RimUnity
ModMetaData.author: chezhou9413, keeptpa
ModMetaData.description:
RimUnity 为 RimWorld 1.7 提供 Unity 资源导出与运行支持，让内容模组使用在 Unity 中制作的粒子、材质、UI、模型和动画，并提供熟悉的脚本接口。需配合支持 RimUnity 的内容模组使用。1.7 依赖 Harmony；1.6 可安装，但不加载功能。
RimUnity brings Unity-authored particles, materials, UI, models and animations to RimWorld 1.7, with familiar scripting APIs. A framework for content mods that support RimUnity. Requires Harmony on 1.7. On 1.6 this is an inactive placeholder.
